    * fix(brain): h_7100 — MAJOR 1 trade regex bare-target {0,3}, MAJOR 2 ZH %
    
    MAJOR 1 (review): bare-target branch (set/cut/raise/lower + target)
    was \s+\S+\s+ (exactly 1 intervening token), changed to (?:\S+\s+){0,3}
    to absorb up to 3 tokens. Fixes Cut NVDA a target of 200 now. being
    mistakenly allowed.
    
    MAJOR 2 (ruling): ZH confidence-% — replaced the bare {1,6} digit-class
    八成 branch with structured alternatives:
    - Explicit 成功率八成把握
    - 成功率\s+(?:digit\s*){1,5}[一-龥]成把握 (prevents greedy over-consumption
      of preceding chars that belong to the reported context)
    - (?<![功达])八成把握(?![。]) (bare 八成把握, blocks 成功率达八成FORMAT)
    
    The (?<![功达]) lookbehind blocks the reportative leak in 成功率达八成把握
    where the preceding 达 (not 功 or 率) was being absorbed by the
    {1,6} quantifier.
    
    Also: (?!\S) -> (?![。\s]) on the \d+% branch allows the MINOR 1
    punctuation cases (80%把握。) to be forbidden.
